column11: Book trials table, asset 2597, which now carries NNC0487-0111's studies too: all 14 Phase 3 trials of the molecule sit on this row. AMAZE 1 (NCT07339423) is the once-weekly subcutaneous trial against placebo in adults with excess weight and no diabetes (HbA1c 6.5% or more excluded), 1,150 enrolled, recruiting since 2026-02-24, body weight at week 84, primary completion 2029-06-26. It is the largest weight-loss trial of the injection and the last to complete; only the heart-failure outcomes trial (NCT07567001, 2029-07-23) is later. The earlier completions are special populations, a maintenance design, the tablet or a head-to-head: AMAZE 12 maintenance (NCT07503210) 2028-06-06, AMAZE 4 and 3 sleep apnoea 2028-06-26 and 2028-07-12, AMAZE 9 tablets (NCT07720271) 2028-06-27, AMAZE 2 type 2 diabetes (NCT07533175) 2028-08-07, AMAZE 6 and NCT07481630 knee osteoarthritis 2028-08-14, NCT07668414 against semaglutide 2028-10-10, AMAZE 8 against semaglutide in type 2 diabetes (NCT07400107) 2028-12-12, AMAZE 13 Asia 2029-01-11, AMAZE 10 Japan 2029-02-05. column12: JUDGEMENT. Novo has published no filing or launch date. Its quarterly reports on sec.gov (read from search excerpts) give AMAZE 8 a readout in H1 2029 and the heart-failure trial, HF-POLARIS, H2 2029. Submission around Q4 2029 after AMAZE 1 and approval around late 2030 on a standard review make 2031 the first full year. AMAZE 1 sets the date because it is the general-population trial a first weight-management label rests on, the role REDEFINE 1 played for CagriSema. The case for earlier: Novo could file on the 2028 readouts and add AMAZE 1 later, or use a priority review, either of which brings launch into 2030. The type 2 diabetes programme (AMBITION 7, NCT07797335, 2028-07-31) could also reach market first under a separate label. The case for later: Novo's own last interval was longer than Lilly's. CagriSema's REDEFINE 1 (NCT05567796) completed on 2024-10-30 (book trials table) and Novo filed on 2025-12-18, 13.6 months later, with a decision expected in Q4 2026 (Novo release, prnewswire 302645862).
